coordinator#1 · hotlong · session_85eb0287cb754f0f9c2bed54cab9abff

待确认项已裁决，正文已同步。

协调席问：「视图上『整页打开』的声明（navigation.mode）在新规则下废弃吗？」维护者 2026-11-20：「废弃」。

- 视图上的 `navigation.mode` 不再决定打开方式，规范里标为废弃并给迁移说明。
- 现有元数据带着这个键时照常加载，行为与没声明一致；过渡方式按规范既有的废弃做法，在 PR 里说明。

triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Feature · opening a record from a list: the name opens the full page, a hover icon on the name cell opens the side panel; drop the "open record" setting and the full-width drawer; the full page keeps the list origin; the drawer becomes a floating card; child of topic #35590, maintainer: 「这样就不需要任何设置」 → p2 as set by the coordinator · size M. Sibling of #35853.

Stop on any other breach and report.
Container & model: `L`, `mode:thread`, `model: default`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: semantic
Responsibility: opening a record from a list has three states (drawer, full-width drawer, page), a per-user setting to pick between two of them, a full-width state that a refresh loses, and a full page that forgets which list it came from | the open mode is a preference plus a view key (`navigation.mode`) instead of one rule (name → page, hover icon → side panel), and the page route carries no list provenance | every user opening records from a list
Thread-read: 7039929512
Premise: holds at `origin/main` 3c038eb1, as the card's current-state section reads it (`ViewSettingsPopover.tsx:145-177`, `navigation-overlay.tsx` `maximizable`). The thread re-measures it before writing code. `navigation.mode` is ruled deprecated (maintainer 2026-11-20 「废弃」, card comment 7039654214): existing metadata must still load.
Pre-claim lane: `ui/packages/**` → `domain:ui`, area ux-4; `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts` text/marker → seat L2 after L1-a.
Pre-claim deps: none. Open-PR overlap: os-sales's draft #35864 (#35685 autosave) edits `data-table.tsx`, `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `ListView.tsx`. This card stays off its hunks, and whichever lands second merges main. ux-2's #35845 is ADR-only. No other open PR touches the surface.
Prior rulings read: navigation.mode,open record,maximizable,drawer,side panel,list provenance,打开记录 → 3 hits; ADR-0050 Decision §2, ADR-0037 Decision §2, ADR-0050 Decision §4; thread: 7039654214 (navigation.mode 「废弃」); repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack.
Scope: card items 1–7 and the `navigation.mode` deprecation; acceptance as written. Folded with #35853 into one PR while ≤3,000 lines; otherwise this card lands first. `Fixes #35854`.

Ruling-zone note: `navigation.mode: 'none'` keeps meaning "rows open nothing" (shared with page list blocks; showcase pages rely on it), and the describe points to `preventNavigation`. `drawer` / `page` / `new_window` are ignored on the object list, the same as having no key.

coordinator#1 · hotlong · session_85eb0287cb754f0f9c2bed54cab9abff

和本卡不冲突，说明一处。2026-11-20T17:02Z

维护者 2026-11-21 定了记录页图 41 的方向，见 objectstack-ai/objectstack#35890：宽屏整页时第一个页签（字段）钉到左栏，右边是其余页签。抽屉里不变，第一个页签仍是字段。

对本卡（打开方式、抽屉改悬浮卡片，已派出）没有改动要求。只提醒一点：从抽屉点「整页打开」后，整页是左右两栏的结构，原来在抽屉里选中的页签要带过去——如果选中的是第一个页签（字段），整页右边停在其余页签的第一个。

The change is the en `navigation` helpText plus a new `navigation.mode` helpText in every locale, filled with the English source in merge mode, with existing translations untouched (+33 / −12). Generated only; no hand edits.
Scope note: #35853 now lands as a second PR after this one merges (the combined diff measured 3,952 lines > 3,000); this card's PR carries `Fixes #35854` only.

File surface (adds; CI fix on PR #35910): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/ConsoleToaster.tsx`, limited to the right-edge drawer detection (`openRightDrawers`). The floating drawer card is now inset 8 px, so the objectui#11685 clearance stopped finding it, and toasts landed top-centre over the drawer header (7 red cases in `ui/e2e/toast-under-modal.spec.ts`). The fix accepts edge insets up to 16 px and adds the card's right and top inset to the width and header clearance. About 7 lines, with a one-line comment change only.

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6Cb8qTxAVaE2QKwquQU

Close-out · 2026-11-21T03:40Z: PR #35910 merged as d6be99d50c (L1-a ACCEPT 7048643367, deltas 7049491215 / 7050677695 / 7052113241; seat Contract review PASS 7050769114, delta 7052849260 at head 25a30f2090; os-zhuang APPROVED 6000005991; os-zhuang enqueued). The card closed on merge.

What changed in the object list: clicking the name opens the full record page, and the page carries list provenance. A hover icon in the name cell opens the side panel, which is now a floating inset card. The 「打开记录」 setting and the maximized drawer are gone, and `openNewTab` is honoured on the name click. `navigation.mode` is deprecated for the object list only (narrowing, ADR-0087 semantic migration entry 18). Page blocks keep their modes.

Follow-ups nested here, all unclaimed: #35870 (ADR-0050 note + skills mentions, governed), #35875 (/data), #35915 (7-locale navigation helpText), #35936 (Studio kanban card inspector modes). #35840 stays open; PR-2 covers it. #35853 is still dispatched and follows as PR-2 from the same thread. pm:dispatched removed.
